title: Dependent GROUP BY cascade obscured the unresolved rename root

firstObservation.query: select a.Country as RegionOut from #A.entities() a group by CountryOut

authority.rule: Dependent expressions are poisoned after an unresolved name; independent sibling roots remain reportable.

changes: Reconstruct a full GROUP BY expression span from parser-node descendants when the qualified DotNode has no direct span.
Associate an unresolved GROUP BY diagnostic with the current nonaggregate projection only when its terminal expression or structured candidate column matches within a compatible source-qualifier set.
Keep independent MQ3001 and MQ3012 sibling roots instead of applying a query-global suppression.
repair.rejectedApproach: A broad overlap-only suppression was rejected after independent review identified qualified alias misses and global suppression of independent projections.

priorReview.disposition: required qualified-span and per-projection regression corrections were applied

finalReviewer.evidence: Reviewed the exact cross-source regression, symmetric probes, focused 9/9 replay and adjacent 36/36 semantic/diagnostic controls.
